metric_models.TWAP_Price: Galaxy rolling TWAP over this galaxy's own window. NOT the lifetime TWAP on the report pages.
metric_models.TWAP_Formatted: Galaxy rolling TWAP, formatted. NOT the lifetime TWAP on the report pages.
metric_models.Prem_Pct: Premium/discount versus the GALAXY rolling TWAP, in percent. NOT the lifetime TWAP premium.
metric_models.TWAP_Signal: Radar axis: this asset's premium min-max normalised across its galaxy, 0-100. Not an input to Composite_Risk.
metric_models.Regression_Signal: Radar axis. A COPY of Gravity (galaxy_dashboard.py: df['Regression_Signal'] = df['Gravity']), not independent information.
metric_models.SMA_Risk: Radar axis: SMA-based risk, 0-100. Not an input to Composite_Risk.
metric_models.Drawdown_Signal: Radar axis: 100 + ATH_Drawdown, clipped to 0-100. Not an input to Composite_Risk.
metric_models.Vol_Beta_Signal: Radar axis: blended volatility and beta, 0-100. Not an input to Composite_Risk.
metric_models.Composite_Risk: max(Gravity, 10) / Dominance_Multiplier -- Gravity weighted for market dominance. UNBOUNDED: observed 11.0 to 616.8 across 114 assets, 24 of them above 100. Never quote it as a score or a percentage; it has no bands. It is the right key to ORDER a peer table on, because raw Gravity flatters wreckage -- a decayed micro-cap sits low in its own range and outranks a major that has not fallen.
metric_models.Comp_Risk: Alias of Composite_Risk as embedded by the page. Same caveats.
metric_models.Dominance_Multiplier: Market-cap dominance weight that divides Gravity to make Composite_Risk.
metric_models.Gravity: Gravity risk 0-100: where today's premium sits inside this asset's own multi-year range of premiums. This is the score the galaxy displays and the only one comparable across assets. Zones (the homepage's bands): accumulation <25, mid-cycle 25-50 (mid-range on the equity galaxies), late-cycle 50-75, cycle top >=75 (top stretch on the equity galaxies). Computed separately from the report pages' Gravity Risk card, which may differ.
metric_models.Gravity_Score: Alias of Gravity as embedded by the page.
metric_models.Current_Price: Spot at galaxy build time. May differ by minutes from the report pages' Current Price.
metric_models.Quadrant: Galaxy quadrant: Golden Breakout, Euphoria, Deep Accumulation or Value Trap.
metric_models.Galaxy_Group: PRIMARY or OUTER ring within this galaxy.
metric_models.Market_Cap_Rank: Rank within this galaxy by market capitalisation.
